# Orbit Engineering Solutions

> Orbit Engineering Solutions (OES) provides water infrastructure, industrial automation and instrumentation services from Bhopal, India. This website is a B2B catalogue and inquiry service. It does not accept online orders or payments.

## Business information
- Operator: Vijay Kumar Tiwari, trading as Orbit Engineering Solutions, a sole proprietorship.
- Business address: GF, E-45, Pride City, Katara Hills, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462043, India.
- Phone: +91 70241 28029; +91 9039075049.
- Email: info@orbitengineerings.com; service@orbitengineerings.com.
- Website: https://orbitengineerings.com/.

## Indicative capabilities
- Water treatment (WTP), sewage treatment (STP), effluent treatment (ETP) and reverse osmosis (RO).
- PLC control panels, SCADA integration, RTU telemetry and IoT monitoring.
- Flow, level, pressure and water-quality instrumentation.
- Valves, electric actuators, chlorination, solar and surveillance equipment.
- Engineering consultancy, installation, commissioning and operation/maintenance, subject to agreed scope.

## Accuracy and commercial limits
Catalogue descriptions and technical values are indicative; confirm the selected model, manufacturer datasheet, certifications, suitability, availability and warranty terms in a written quotation. Product images may illustrate a category. Third-party names identify the relevant organisations or products and do not imply endorsement. Project references do not establish a direct appointment or prime-contract role. No independent certification verification, aggregate customer rating or total project-value claim is made here. Request current supporting documents from the team.
